summary: Frame prediction tasks, prepare data, and evaluate introductory models with Python and scikit-learn. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Machine learning training for professionals covers framing prediction tasks, preparing tabular data, and evaluating introductory models. It is for analysts, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and domain specialists who assess prediction tasks and communicate findings. Using Python, Jupyter notebooks, and scikit-learn, learners check data quality, build and compare baseline models, choose suitable metrics, analyze errors, and explain limitations in responsible-use reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to assess whether a prediction task is practical, prepare data, evaluate introductory models, and communicate results within their work. It suits foundation-level learners, including people who contribute domain knowledge or review model outputs rather than build production systems.
prerequisites: Prior machine-learning experience is not required. Basic spreadsheet use and familiarity with tabular data are recommended. Python notebook coding is required for the hands-on model exercises.
